name: useGenAITasks
summary: Four focused text tasks that run locally: summarise, proofread, rewrite, describe.
plain: Purpose-built text helpers that run on the phone. Each does one job well and is faster and more reliable than prompting a general model for the same thing. No network, no key.
description: Wraps the ML Kit GenAI task modules on AICore through pixel-nano: genai-summarization, genai-proofreading and genai-rewriting, plus image description. Because each task ships a tuned model rather than a free-form prompt, the output is more consistent than asking a chat model, and it works on more devices. Every call reports its own measured latency and the engine that served it.

returns.name: isRunning
returns.desc: True while any task is executing.

returns.name: summaryResult
returns.desc: Bullet summary with latency and engine name.

returns.name: proofreadResult
returns.desc: Corrected text plus the individual suggestions.

returns.name: rewriteResult
returns.desc: Rewritten text in the requested tone.

returns.name: imageDescriptionResult
returns.desc: Generated description of a supplied image.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Why the last task failed, for example the model not being downloaded.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

actions.name: summarize(text, options?)
actions.desc: Condenses an article or a conversation on-device. Nothing leaves the phone.

inputs.name: text
inputs.desc: The article or transcript to condense.

inputs.name: options
inputs.desc: inputType: 'article' or 'conversation' tells the model how to read it; outputType: 'one_bullet', 'two_bullets' or 'three_bullets' sets the length.

actions.output: Resolves with { summary, latencyMs, engine, source }, or null on failure with the reason in error.

actions.name: proofread(text)
actions.desc: Fixes grammar, punctuation and wording. Good for cleaning up dictated text.
actions.output: Resolves with { correctedText, suggestions, latencyMs, engine, source } — suggestions lists the individual changes — or null on failure.

actions.name: rewrite(text, tone?)
actions.desc: Rewrites text in a different tone or length while keeping the meaning.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.desc: One of elaborate, emojify, shorten, friendly, professional, rephrase. Defaults to professional.

actions.output: Resolves with { rewrittenText, suggestions, latencyMs, engine, source }, or null on failure.

actions.name: describeImage(input, style?)
actions.desc: Describes an image locally. Useful for alt text without a network round-trip.

inputs.name: imageInput
inputs.desc: A file URI or a base64 image.

inputs.name: style
inputs.desc: detailed, caption, labels or concise. Defaults to concise.

actions.output: Resolves with { description, finishReason, latencyMs, engine, source }, or null on failure.

agentNote: Reach for these before prompting a chat model for the same job: they are faster, run offline and give steadier output. Handle the model-not-downloaded error.
